item.tib: phywa g.yang cha lag me mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i dngos grub g.yang gi sgrab pa'i las kha bsang mchod sbyin sreg 'di yang / ston pa 'chi med (gtsug phud) kyis ma 'ongs don du gnod sbyin sde tshogs las la bsdus shing / sgrub thabs zab mo gtan la phab nas/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan/ des lha klu mi yi gshen gsum la bstan/ des naMm mkha' snang ba mdog can la bstan/ des bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la bstan/ des rgyas 'bring bsdus par phyes nas/ grol thob sems dpa' brgyad la gdams/ dus der ban btsun phrag dog dbang gis bon rnams bsnabs nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis bon sde cha gnyis phyes nas/ cha gcig rgyung srub brag la sbas/ cha gcig rig 'dzin mu la sgron gsal gyis (gyi) phyag tu phul nas/ de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ma dros g.yi yi mtsho mo'i dbus rnam rgyal dbang mchog gi pho brang nang du gter du sbas/ gter srung rdo rje 'bar ba dang klu mo dkar mo la bcol lo/ phyis dus dang skabs su bab pa'i dus su/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis ma dros lung bstan nas/ bka' gter chig dril du 'gro mgon tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis (byin gyis rlabs) pa'i bus (bu)/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la/ dngos grub tu bab pa'o/ de la sngon du da lta'i dus su bstan 'gro'i grogs por gyur ba'i dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs sngon gyi bag chags 'phro sad rin chen dang po mar zhi dang / rten 'brel zab pa'i sna drangs nas bskyal ba dang / ma zad shel bla tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis bskur ba dang / nye gnas dpal sdis dang / dkon mchog dang / bstan mchog sogs dad can 'ga' yis bskul ngor/ smin grol gling du yi ger bris pa'o//
